Kharge Alleges Madhya Pradesh is Epicenter of Corruption Under BJP

Congress leader Mallikarjun Kharge has accused the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) of making Madhya Pradesh an "epicenter of corruption and loot." Kharge specifically targeted the BJP over an alleged ethanol scam. This statement comes amidst ongoing political discourse regarding governance and alleged malpractices in the state.
